---
title: "Spacing between motifs"
subtitle: "How much room the computer gets"
---

The number of free knitted rows between two motifs is a setting that affects every method. All three banners below use stitch-by-stitch sampling.

With little space the motifs almost touch and the banner is mostly copied. With a lot of space the computer has to invent long transitions, which is where the choice of method matters most.

```{=html}
<div class="banner-viewer" data-method="spacing"></div>
<script src="../js/banner-viewer.js"></script>
```
